turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi. My subscription was removed but I want to have it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, what's your name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alessandro Phoenix

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you Alessandro.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How did you learn that your subscription had been removed?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I heard from a spouse

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Gotcha. Let me see if it was actually removed from your account, just a moment.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been updated with add service.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It looks like the information you heard was correct, and it was in fact removed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: However, I have reinstated your subscription.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: great. thanks so much

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There's nothing to worry about, and you're not being charged extra or anything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no that's all

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Also, when looking at your account it should show the subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If it's not available immediately, it may just take a few minutes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please do reach back out to us if it does not in fact appear on your account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: With that being said, I thank you for getting in touch with us. I hope you have an excellent day.
